programmes.d: A mix of jealousy and infidelity plunges Amanda Hornsby and Woody Smith into an abyss of sex and violence.
As Sharon and Perry Nelson's marriage falters, a new lover brings more than a dash of violence into the mix.
When Hattie Rennolds and her husband divorce, chaos enters their custody dispute, and someone ends up dead.
Judy Parker's rumored romantic entanglements with her husband's employees become too much for him to bear.
Marcia's relationship with James endures many hardships, culminating in six arrests and one dead body.
When pro football player Tommy Kane's career ends, close proximity to his wife Tamara tears them apart.
When Ray discovers his wife Karla is no longer loyal to him after 20 years of marriage, his dark side emerges.
Arthur believes it's true love when he falls for Patricia. But years later, tensions arise, and someone snaps.
Tami and Alan marry quickly. But when Tami starts using her looks to get what she wants, things turn deadly.
Tanya and Michel's relationship unravels, and a suspicious suicide has friends pointing fingers at friends.
Larry thinks Tammy is having an affair. When they go on a hunting trip, one of them becomes the hunted.
When the marital bliss of Russell and Barbara gives way to lies and betrayal, someone is pushed over the edge.
Tony Smith learns his common-law wife is still legally married to someone else and spirals down a dark path.
Story of the Hong Kong native and former Marine who, along with his friend Leonard Lake, was responsible for a grisly series of crimes.

The controversial case of Native-American activist Leonard Peltier, who is serving consecutive life sentences for the murder of two FBI agents in 1975 at the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation near Oglala, South Dakota.
Conor McInnerney stopped breathing while breastfeeding and was rushed to the hospital in 1998. Eugene Turner, a doctor on the case, was charged with murder after a nurse saw him smother the child.
The bizarre story of Michael Pardue, an Alabama man who was imprisoned on three murder charges and who escaped from prison three times and was recaptured.

The notorious case of Kenneth McDuff, the most infamous sexual predator in Texas history, who was sent to death row for three murders, released because of prison overcrowding, and then raped and killed two more women.
The story of how an enterprising reporter, a private investigator, and federal authorities unraveled the mystery behind the 1995 disappearance of the founder of the American Atheist organization.
Eduardo and Jayne face a living nightmare when Eduardo is kidnapped, confined in a small box, brutally tortured, injected with tainted blood and shot twice.
Two women fight for their lives when a knife-wielding attacker ambushes them on a mountain trail and two men on vacation survive 14 hours adrift at sea after their ship sinks in 15 to 20 foot waves.
When her husband threatens her with divorce, an Arkansas hunter sets the scene for a tragic accident that's actually a murder.
A ballet dancer is bludgeoned to death with her own point shoes, and investigators find a bookish body double waiting in the wings.
When a rotting corpse is discovered in the trunk of a car, detectives uncover a sordid plot that includes a nouveau riche computer geek and a pair of seasoned golddiggers.
Looking to make a quick buck, two crooked trainers kidnap and kill their wealthy client. And though he survives to tell the tale, police dismiss his outrageous story.
Envy rears its ugly head in the sordid tale of a successful geek and two down-on-their-luck jocks.
Claiming to be possessed by the spinster spirit of a murdered woman she barely knew, a New Orleans nurse leads cops straight to the killer.
A two-timing German cheesemaker is poisoned by bratwurst, and the dead man's girlfriend immediately points to the 'other woman'.
Dead women and mutilated mannequins pop up in a Texas town. And it will take a broken window, a pizza box, and a few stray hairs to track down a homicidal postman.
A privileged prep school kid will do anything to live on easy street, and when his father forces him to come clean, dad's ultimatum proves deadly.
Targeted by an obsessed cyber-stalker, a womanizing basketball star's fiancée is gunned down in his home.
When a doomsday survivalist is shot dead in his bunker, his daughter and son-in-law incriminate themselves with a story about masked intruders and the power of prayer.
A cupcake-baking homemaker gets away with murder. That is, until she tries it on husband number two.
